info.title: WalkSafe Android Gateway API
info.description: Single-process Android gateway contract, including bounded email signup relays, Backend-bound password sessions, bounded authenticated STT/TTS relays, fixed report transport receipts, v7 actor/generation-bound report content rights, authenticated integrated-consent bootstrap with Backend CAS, and durable account-deletion v2 fencing with capability recovery. Every response is Cache-Control: no-store. Any public route may also answer 503 gateway_trusted_client_ip_unavailable in production when the reverse proxy did not set the trusted client IP header to exactly one valid address (S19-53), and 504 gateway_request_deadline_exceeded when its Node handler passed the outer whole-request deadline. Outside navigation, S19-59 sets the deadline to limits a request can meet in sequence plus 5 seconds (35 seconds for an ordinary route); navigation uses separate 8-second walking and 7-second search outer deadlines and shorter inner deadlines. The outcome of an outer deadline answer is unknown, so a client repeats only an idempotent request with the same request ID.

post.description: Public bounded relay. The JSON body is limited to 4096 bytes and exact-key validated before Backend service authentication. Backend responses are limited to 16384 bytes and projected through strict success and error allowlists.

Public bounded relay. The JSON body is limited to 16384 bytes and requires exact consent document-version and selection keys. The new password needs 12..128 code points (422 account_create_request_invalid otherwise); a common or easily guessed password is refused with 400 account_password_too_common. A required signup document version that is not current, or an optional one that is neither current nor a server-known prior version, is refused with 409 signup_consent_outdated (S01-3, GWBE-04); a known prior optional version never blocks creation and its grant is recorded as not given. Password, OTP, email, and enrollment handles are never included in Gateway telemetry.

get.description: Without a query, returns the current session status and exact session_scope, optionally including a fresh server capacity snapshot. With exactly devices=true, requires a general-scope current long-lived access cookie and lists only that actor's active devices without a capacity snapshot.

200.description: Current field session state or actor-bound device list

post.description: Body limit 4096 bytes; body-read timeout 10 seconds. Login purpose defaults to general for legacy request compatibility. Short login returns its exact session_scope; account_deletion_recovery is always short-lived and cannot include device_id. An enabled general device login or one-time refresh returns split access-cookie and refresh-token credentials. A consumed refresh-token reuse revokes every long-lived family of the account (owner decision 1). S19-10: before any session state is read, a refresh is limited per trusted client address (60 per minute) and per claimed actor and refresh family (30 refused refresh verdicts, 400/401/403/409, per minute; client cancellation and deadline answers do not count) with 429 field_session_refresh_rate_limited (retryable, Retry-After), and to 16 in progress with 503 field_session_storage_busy (retryable). S19-11: 503 field_session_storage_unavailable (retryable) means nothing was committed and the presented refresh proof is still valid; a failure after the commit is 500 field_session_storage_outcome_unknown.

200.description: Short scoped session or general long-lived device session established, or a general device session atomically rotated

Set-Cookie.description: Short-lived walksafe_field_session access cookie; Path=/; HttpOnly; SameSite=Strict; Secure on HTTPS

delete.description: With device_id, requires a current long-lived access cookie and idempotently revokes that actor's device. S19-4-F1 (FP-011): revoking a device other than the requester's own is a sensitive account change and needs a credential login within the account-deletion window (5 minutes); otherwise 401 field_session_reauthentication_required (reauthentication_required: true) and nothing is revoked. Revoking the requester's own device and the plain logout are not gated. Without a query, revokes the current family by access cookie or by the optional JSON refresh proof. Refresh proof values never belong in the URL or headers. A valid, mismatched, or already-revoked well-formed proof returns the same 204 to avoid a token oracle.

204.description: Idempotent revoke accepted; the cookie is expired when the current session is cleared

get.description: Returns the account current live walk. Requires a general-scope v4 long-lived field cookie; holder identity is derived only from that server session.

post.description:
Acquires, takes over, renews, or ends the account live walk with a 90 second server-time lease.

503 field_walk_ledger_unavailable means the ledger was not changed. 503 field_walk_ledger_outcome_unknown (retry: same_request_id, Retry-After: 1) means storage failed after the atomic rename, so the command may already be committed: retry with the same request_id, which replays the stored result; a new request_id is not safe.

S19-17: commands are walksafe.field-walk-command.v2 (v1 plus issued_at_epoch_ms, fixed per request_id). v1 carries no issue time and is refused by default with 409 walk_command_version_retired (nothing executed); an explicit Gateway legacy setting can accept v1. Idempotency guarantee: a cached request_id replays its stored result; an uncached v2 request issued more than 24 hours before or after both the ledger server time and the wall clock, or not newer than an evicted request of the same device (per-account cache of 4096), and an evicted v1 start, return 409 idempotency_expired without executing.

S01-31: while the account remembers an explicitly ended walk_id (end, logout, remote revoke; 30 days, at most 256 walks) it keeps the issue time of the ending command (issued_at_epoch_ms of a v2 end, otherwise the server time). A start or takeover of that walk_id issued at or before it is a replay and returns 409 walk_already_ended, independent of the request cache; one issued later runs as a new command. A v1 start or takeover (no issue time) is refused.

S19-20: lease time follows the server monotonic clock inside the process. After a wall-clock step above 2 seconds, start and takeover return 503 field_walk_clock_unavailable for 90 seconds; renew and end continue. The absorbed step is persisted, so a restart keeps the same server time; after the window server time returns to the wall clock (immediately for a forward step, leases from before it keep their remaining time; at most 10% slower for a backward step up to 10 minutes; immediately for larger backward steps). A lease whose remaining time exceeds 90 seconds is cut to 90 seconds, never extended. Clients should stamp issued_at_epoch_ms from the returned server_time_epoch_ms.

200.description: Field walk command applied or idempotently replayed

409.description: Lease or request id conflict, or idempotency_expired, walk_already_ended, or walk_command_version_retired (not executed)

post.description: General field session required. Accepts one bounded raw audio body, relays it to the loopback Voice service with a dedicated internal token, and removes intent, action, slots, segments, and timestamps from the mobile response.

200.description: Bounded transcript and acoustic execution evidence

post.description: General field session required. Exact JSON is translated to a non-caching, no-server-fallback Qwen3-TTS request. Only a bounded, duration-checked WAV is returned.

200.description: Validated Qwen3-TTS WAV; safety-critical Android guidance still requires the on-device TTS/vibration fallback

post.description:
Field session required. Body limit 16384 bytes; the body reader's own timeout is 10 seconds, but the navigation handler includes account-session gate, request body, Backend call, and complete response body in one 7.5-second deadline (Node outer deadline 8 seconds). The Backend fetch and full response body have a 5-second limit and a 2097152-byte maximum. Android limits the whole call to 10 seconds (connect 2 seconds, read 9 seconds). A navigation handler deadline returns 504 gateway_navigation_timeout; an upstream deadline returns 504 gateway_upstream_timeout; a response above the byte limit returns 502 gateway_upstream_response_too_large. Cancellation ends body reads and upstream work.

Walk ownership gate: while another device or session of the same account holds the active field walk, the Gateway returns 409 walk_owned_by_other_device before any Backend call. With no active walk, or when the caller's own session holds it, nothing changes. An unreadable or busy field walk ledger fails closed with 503 field_walk_ledger_unavailable.

get.description: Field session required. Account-session gate, Backend call, and complete response body share one 6.5-second navigation handler deadline (Node outer deadline 7 seconds). The Backend fetch and full response body have a 5-second limit and a 2097152-byte maximum. Android limits the whole call to 10 seconds (connect 2 seconds, read 9 seconds). A navigation handler deadline returns 504 gateway_navigation_timeout; an upstream deadline returns 504 gateway_upstream_timeout; a response above the byte limit returns 502 gateway_upstream_response_too_large. Cancellation ends upstream work. Destination search does not run the walk ownership gate.

post.description:
Field session required. Total multipart limit 9437184 bytes; body and upstream timeouts are each 15 seconds; one upload may be in flight.

Walk ownership gate: after field authentication and before the body is read or any Backend call, a request from another device or session of an account whose active field walk is held elsewhere returns 409 walk_owned_by_other_device, and an unreadable or busy field walk ledger fails closed with 503 field_walk_ledger_unavailable. Owner decision 3(b) (2026-09-29): queued reports are sent only after the walk has ended, so while the caller's own device session holds the account's active field walk the Gateway returns 409 report_walk_in_progress at the same point (no body read, no Backend call); the client keeps the report queued and retries after the walk ends.

The three report transport headers are required. If any is missing, the gateway returns 422 report_transport_headers_incomplete before reading the body or calling Backend. The gateway validates their canonical form and forwards only their exact parsed values with the server-derived FIELD actor binding.

The header purpose must match multipart metadata.auto_reported before any backend fetch.

x-walksafe-report-purpose is an authenticated first-party Android declaration inside the gateway trust boundary, not cryptographic client attestation. The gateway fail-closes when it disagrees with multipart metadata.auto_reported. A tampered but otherwise authenticated client is NOT_COVERED.

image.description: Exactly one JPEG image; 1 to 8388608 bytes

409.description: Consent receipt, actor generation, or processing epoch is stale; or walk_owned_by_other_device when another device or session of the same account holds the active field walk, or report_walk_in_progress while the caller's own device session holds it (both returned before any Backend call).

428.description: Required current transport or integrated-consent receipt headers are missing or unsupported.

parameters.name: x-walksafe-network-transport
parameters.description: Current transport; cellular independently requires mobile-network-transfer consent.

parameters.name: x-walksafe-consent-receipt-sha256
parameters.description: SHA-256 receipt for the current consent revision.

parameters.name: x-walksafe-report-purpose
parameters.description: Authenticated first-party Android declaration. explicit does not require optional raw-source consent; automatic requires automatic-reporting consent, and cellular transfer separately requires mobile-network consent. Both require the current Backend consent receipt and actor binding.

parameters.name: x-walksafe-report-id
parameters.description: Canonical lowercase client report UUID. Must occur with both payload headers.

parameters.name: x-walksafe-report-payload-sha256
parameters.description: Lowercase full transport payload SHA-256. Must occur with report id and payload bytes.

parameters.name: x-walksafe-report-payload-bytes
parameters.description: Positive metadata-plus-image byte count. Must occur with report id and payload SHA-256.

get.description: Returns only the authenticated FIELD actor's persisted transport receipt and coarse user status. Missing and different actors receive the same 404. Backend response bodies are limited to 4096 bytes and projected through a strict allowlist.

Lists only the current v7 Backend-account device session's actor and account generation reports. Query and Backend JSON are strictly allowlisted; Backend response bodies are limited to 131072 bytes. Missing, tombstoned, fenced, and different subjects are concealed. Optional integrated consent is not required for this user right.

Lists the current v7 Backend-account device actor and account generation's active user requests together with content-free physical-deletion tombstones. This global discovery path restores the list after reinstall without prior report identifiers. Optional report_id filtering, pagination query fields, and the v1 Backend projection are strictly allowlisted; response bodies are limited to 49152 bytes. Tombstones expose only deletion completion and external-copy status, never reconstructed request text or status. Missing and different-subject filtered reports receive the same concealed 404. Optional integrated consent is not required.

Returns the exact v2 physical-deletion status and minimal institution-level external-copy deletion facts for a canonical request UUID previously issued to the current v7 Backend-account device actor and account generation. Backend response bodies are limited to 131072 bytes. The request remains queryable after the report itself becomes 404. Missing and different-subject requests receive the same concealed 404. Optional integrated consent is not required.

Returns the strict minimum lifecycle projection for one report owned by the current v7 Backend-account device actor and account generation. Missing, tombstoned, fenced, and different subjects receive the same 404. Optional integrated consent is not required.

Returns the exact current append-only content revision for a report owned by the current v7 Backend-account device actor and account generation. Backend response bodies are limited to 131072 bytes. Revision zero has null user description, category, and correction time. Missing and different-subject reports receive the same concealed 404. Optional integrated consent is not required.

post.description: Appends or exactly replays one structured report-content revision for the current v7 Backend-account device actor and account generation. Request bodies are limited to 4096 bytes and Backend response bodies to 131072 bytes. expected_revision is compare-and-swap and idempotency_key is a canonical UUID. At least one patch field is required: omission preserves its current value and explicit null clears it. Optional integrated consent is not required.

Legacy compatibility path that creates or exactly replays one free-text CORRECTION or DELETE intent without modifying the report. It requires the current v7 Backend-account device actor and account generation. JSON bodies are limited to 4096 bytes and contain exactly the three documented fields. Optional integrated consent is not required.

get.description: Returns one public request-status projection bound to the current v7 Backend-account device actor, account generation, and owned report. Both identifiers must be canonical UUIDs and query parameters are not accepted. Missing, fenced, different-subject, different-generation, report-mismatched, and request-mismatched resources receive the same concealed 404. Optional integrated consent is not required.

put.description: Accepts one canonical raw manifest only from a current v7 Backend-account device session of the same account generation, for a walk that has ended. Owner decision 3(b) (2026-09-29): every raw write (manifest, chunk, commit) names the walk's original id in x-walksafe-raw-walk-id and is admitted only when that walk was held by this account and device and ended (explicit end, logout or remote revoke, lease expiry, or takeover) within the last 30 days, and no walk of the account is active. Otherwise the Gateway returns 409 raw_collection_walk_in_progress (a walk of the account is active; retry after it ends) or 409 raw_collection_walk_not_uploadable (unknown walk, another account's or device's walk, older than 30 days, or dropped from the bounded 256-walk per-account history; entries past 30 days are pruned whenever the account's walk ledger is read), before the body is read. The Gateway performs a same-path HEAD admission check before reading the body and revalidates the session, ended walk, privacy generation, and authoritative Backend consent receipt after each I/O boundary.

Streams exactly one digest-bound chunk through the bounded Gateway relay. Content-Length is mandatory and the Gateway holds at most one 8 MiB chunk while hashing it. Owner decision 3(b): the same ended-walk gate as the manifest applies before the body is read and after consent validation, returning 409 raw_collection_walk_in_progress (a walk of the account is active; retry after it ends) or 409 raw_collection_walk_not_uploadable (not a walk this account and device ended within the last 30 days or still in the bounded 256-walk history).

get.description: Recovers a collection status with the same current v7 Backend-account session, account generation, and privacy generation. An active walk and current consent are intentionally not required for recovery.

post.description: Commits one complete collection into the 14-day quarantine lifecycle and returns a strict receipt v2. Legacy receipt v1 remains readable only from status recovery for collections committed before the v2 rollout. Owner decision 3(b): the same ended-walk gate as the manifest applies before the body is read and after consent validation, returning 409 raw_collection_walk_in_progress (a walk of the account is active; retry after it ends) or 409 raw_collection_walk_not_uploadable (not a walk this account and device ended within the last 30 days or still in the bounded 256-walk history).

head.description: Returns headers for the public privacy-rights HTML page with an empty body. This method is supported only without consent control query parameters; the integrated-consent control API permits GET and PUT.

200.description: Public privacy-rights page headers; empty body. Cache-Control: no-store.

405.description: HEAD is not supported by the integrated-consent control API.

503.description: Privacy-rights page destination is not configured.

get.description: Returns either the authenticated actor/generation- and installation-secret-bound current consent record for control=integrated-consent or the authenticated actor/generation-bound Backend bootstrap projection for control=integrated-consent-bootstrap. Both forms require exactly control, installation_id, and policy_version. An actor-binding mismatch returns integrated_consent_actor_reconsent_required without exposing another actor's selections. S19-31: control=integrated-consent returns the local confirmation (current: true) only after the Backend bootstrap reports READY/CURRENT_CONSENT with the same selections and item versions as the confirmation; a newer receipt from another installation of the account that re-recorded the same selections stays current (S19-31-F1), while different selections or RECONSENT_REQUIRED return 409 integrated_consent_reconsent_required, and a Backend failure fails closed with the Backend or gateway error. A GET without control parameters serves the separate public privacy-rights HTML page.

put.description: Records four independent consent selections only after a live field session and exact backend consent receipt confirm the mutation. The query contains exactly control=integrated-consent. S19-27: 503 integrated_consent_outcome_unknown (detail.retry: same_request_id, Retry-After: 1) means the local write may already be durable; resend the same request_id, which replays the stored confirmation or adopts the Backend idempotent receipt.

post.description: Durably fences the authenticated actor generation before forwarding the exact v2 request. The first request accepts a general or account_deletion_recovery field session and requires a 32-byte client capability; exact retries require only that capability. S19-44: a new request whose last credential login (password or field token, including an account_deletion_recovery login; a refresh does not count) is older than 5 minutes, or whose login time cannot be read, is refused with 401 account_deletion_reauthentication_required (reauthentication_required: true) and nothing is recorded; replay, status and device evidence stay capability-only. A 503 means the gateway fence and outbox remain durable but no canonical backend status has been returned.

get.description: Refreshes canonical backend deletion status using only the request-bound recovery capability.

post.description: Durably queues exact, receipt-linked device deletion evidence and forwards it with status-revision CAS. The raw recovery capability is never forwarded or persisted by the gateway.

deletionAccessSecret.name: x-walksafe-deletion-access-secret
deletionAccessSecret.description: Unpadded base64url encoding of exactly 32 random client-generated bytes. Retained only by the Android encrypted fallback marker.

consentControlSecret.name: x-walksafe-consent-control-secret
consentControlSecret.description: Exactly 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters generated and retained by the Android encrypted preference store.

RawChunkSha256.name: x-walksafe-chunk-sha256
RawChunkSha256.description: SHA-256 of the raw chunk bytes, not a JSON contract digest.

RawCommitSha256.name: x-walksafe-raw-commit-sha256
RawCommitSha256.description: Domain-separated canonical digest of the commit body.

RawConsentReceiptSha256.name: x-walksafe-consent-receipt-sha256
RawConsentReceiptSha256.description: Authoritative Backend consent receipt. A Gateway audit-record hash is never accepted here.

RawNetworkTransport.name: x-walksafe-network-transport
RawNetworkTransport.description: GENERAL_RAW accepts wifi only. AUTO_REPORT on cellular additionally requires mobile-network consent.

FieldSessionError.description: S01-20 public /api/field-session error contract. The code is at `code` or `detail.code`; clients map the listed code, HTTP status and flags to x-walksafe-error-contract.next_action and treat any other code as REAUTHENTICATE. gateway_method_not_allowed (405, Allow header) answers methods the path does not declare.

password.description: New account password: 12..128 Unicode code points without NUL (login keeps accepting 10..128 for existing accounts). The Gateway rejects other lengths with 422 account_create_request_invalid before any Backend call; the Backend refuses common or easily guessed values with 400 account_password_too_common, which the Gateway relays without echoing the password.

remember_me.description: When false, the bounded 12-hour cookie omits Max-Age and is browser-session scoped.

device_id.description: Optional canonical per-install identifier. When present, the fixed 12-hour Backend account session is issued as device-bound v7 and may authorize field-walk; it is not a refresh-token session. The value is an installation identifier, not a per-request proof that the caller holds a registered device key; the cookie remains a bearer credential.

session_mode.description: Owner decision 2 (2026-09-29) / S19-1: opt-in Backend email long-lived login. Requires device_id and remember_me=true and an enabled long-lived Gateway (otherwise 503 field_long_lived_sessions_unavailable). The 200 body is FieldLongSession: a short access cookie plus a rotating refresh token for a family bound to the account generation, auth epoch and device; Backend account currency is still checked on every request and refresh. Without this field the v7 short session is unchanged.

device_id.description: Stable per-install identifier; starts a long-lived device family only when that mode is explicitly enabled and fully configured. It is not a per-request device-key proof: access cookies and refresh tokens are bearer credentials. Forbidden with account_deletion_recovery purpose.

purpose.description: Authorization scope for a short session. account_deletion_recovery is never device-bound or refreshable.

refresh_token.description: Opaque secret sent only in a JSON request body and returned only in a successful JSON response

account_generation.description: Required for Backend email long sessions, absent for legacy actor/token sessions. Immutable across refresh and retained by Android encrypted persistence and restore.
Required for Backend email long sessions, absent for legacy actor/token sessions. Immutable across refresh and retained by Android encrypted persistence and restore.

EpochMillisecondsOrUnlimited.description: Owner decision 2 (2026-09-29): null when the Gateway is configured with an unlimited refresh idle or absolute lifetime; the login then never expires by idle time or age and ends only by logout, revocation or re-authentication. An unlimited idle expiry implies an unlimited absolute expiry.

expected_revision.description: Compare-and-swap revision observed from the current content resource.

user_description.description: Omission preserves the current description; explicit null clears it. Non-null input is NFC-normalized, whitespace-collapsed, and rejects Unicode control categories.

category_hint.description: Omission preserves the current category; explicit null clears it.

ReportDeletionStatus.description: external_copy_count exactly equals external_copies length; external_copies is empty unless state is DELETED.

UserReportRequestHistoryItem.description: ACTIVE_REQUEST requires request; CORRECTION requires null deletion_status, while DELETE requires a matching non-DELETED deletion_status and status_version. DELETION_TOMBSTONE requires null request and a DELETED deletion_status. report_id and request_id must match every nested projection.

UserReportRequestHistoryPage.description: Newest-first, immutable snapshot page. Item revisions are unique and strictly decreasing, do not exceed snapshot_revision, and total_count is the snapshot result count. The optional cursor is opaque and bound to the current actor, account generation, report filter, and snapshot.

RawCollectionManifestV1.description: Canonical UTF-8 JSON with lexically sorted unique object IDs, contiguous chunk indexes, exact aggregate counters, and manifest_sha256=SHA256('walksafe/raw-collection-manifest/v1\0' || canonical JSON without manifest_sha256).

RawCollectionCommitV1.description: commit_sha256 is carried only in the header and equals SHA256('walksafe/raw-collection-commit/v1\0' || canonical body).

RawCollectionReceiptV1.description: Legacy read-only receipt with exact RAW_ORIGINAL_180D retention. receipt_sha256 is domain-separated over the canonical receipt without receipt_sha256.

RawCollectionReceiptV2.description: Current commit receipt with exact RAW_QUARANTINE_14D retention. receipt_sha256 uses the v2 domain over the canonical receipt without receipt_sha256.

issued_at_epoch_ms.description: S19-17: client time fixed when request_id is created and resent unchanged on every retry of that request_id.
S19-17: client time fixed when request_id is created and resent unchanged on every retry of that request_id.
S19-17: client time fixed when request_id is created and resent unchanged on every retry of that request_id.

FieldWalkIdempotencyExpired.description: S19-17: the request_id is not in the idempotency cache and is outside its guarantee (a v2 issued_at_epoch_ms more than 24 hours from server time or not newer than an evicted request of the same device, or an evicted v1 start). The command was not executed; re-read GET /api/field-walk instead of retrying the same request_id.

FieldWalkAlreadyEnded.description: S01-31: the walk_id was explicitly ended for this account (retained 30 days, at most 256 walks) and this start or takeover was issued at or before the ending command (or carries no issue time), so it is treated as a replay; nothing was executed and no fencing token was consumed. A command issued after the end runs normally.

FieldWalkCommandVersionRetired.description: S19-17: a walksafe.field-walk-command.v1 command was refused because v1 has no issue time for the idempotency window (default; an explicit Gateway legacy setting can accept v1). Nothing was executed; resend as v2.

FieldWalkClockUnavailableError.description: S19-20: a server wall-clock step above 2 seconds was detected within the last lease TTL (90 s of monotonic time). New activation (start/takeover) fails closed; the current holder can still renew or end.

ReportWalkInProgressError.description: Owner decision 3(b) (2026-09-29): report v2 is refused while the caller's own device session holds the account's active field walk; queued reports are sent after the walk ends. No body is read and no Backend call is made.

WalkOwnedByOtherDeviceError.description: Walk ownership gate refusal on walking routes and report v2 while another device or session of the same account holds the active field walk. Takeover goes through POST /api/field-walk.

FieldWalkLedgerUnavailableError.description: The field walk ledger could not be read or locked; the request fails closed and the ledger is unchanged.

FieldWalkLedgerOutcomeUnknownError.description: Storage failed after the atomic rename, so the command may be committed. Retry with the same request_id (replays the stored result); a new request_id is not safe.

expected_previous_backend_receipt_sha256.description: Backend CAS predecessor from the authenticated bootstrap response. Null is valid only when the Backend revision floor is zero.

gateway_audit_record_sha256.description: Gateway-local immutable audit-chain record hash. It is never an authorization receipt.

backend_consent_receipt_sha256.description: Authoritative Backend consent receipt used for authorization.

items.description: Canonical order: device_untransmitted_data, server_originals, server_quarantine, server_copies, report_records, training_datasets, training_labels, derived_artifacts, backups.

FieldSessionError.description: Registered /api/field-session error (S01-20). The code, HTTP status and retryable / reauthentication_required flags follow components.schemas.FieldSessionError x-walksafe-error-contract; any other code means REAUTHENTICATE.

AccountEnrollmentEmailOtp.description: Opaque email OTP enrollment handle metadata

AccountCreated.description: Backend-created account identity and signup receipt

UserReportRequestHistory.description: Strict actor/generation-bound active-request and content-free deletion-tombstone history page

ReportRateLimited.description: The actor report-operation rate limit was exceeded. The response body is generated by the Gateway and does not expose the Backend error body.

ReportContentCurrent.description: Strict actor/generation-bound current report content revision

ReportContentRevision.description: Created or exactly replayed structured report content revision

ReportDeletionStatus.description: Strict actor/generation-bound v2 physical and external-copy report deletion status

RawCollectionStatus.description: Strict current-generation raw collection status projection

RawCollectionReceipt.description: Strict domain-digest-validated 14-day quarantine receipt v2 projection

WalkOwnedByOtherDevice.description: walk_owned_by_other_device: another device or session of the same account holds the active field walk; no Backend call was made

FieldWalkLedgerUnavailable.description: Fail-closed dependency failure: field_walk_ledger_unavailable when the walk ownership gate cannot read or lock the field walk ledger (no Backend call was made), or another bounded Gateway storage/security unavailability

FieldWalkUnavailable.description: Gateway security is not configured, field_walk_ledger_unavailable (ledger unchanged), field_walk_ledger_outcome_unknown (command may be committed; Retry-After: 1 and retry the same request_id), or field_walk_clock_unavailable (start/takeover only, ledger unchanged)

IntegratedConsentRead.description: Strict current-consent or authenticated bootstrap projection selected by the control query

AccountDeletionConflict.description: A stale evidence revision returns the canonical deletion status; request/body/operation/binding and other permanent conflicts return a bounded gateway error and are durably quarantined from retry.

AccountDeletionPending.description: The durable gateway fence or outbox exists, but canonical backend processing is unavailable. Retry with the same request id, body, revision, and capability. S19-27: code privacy_deletion_outcome_unknown (retry: same_request_id, Retry-After: 1) means the deletion ledger write may already be durable; the same exact retry replays it and the status route re-reads it.
